title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and the letter on the price basis.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.17 (po:4500013023-10) through EUR 5.24 (po:4500013392-10), EUR 5.43 (po:4500013795-10) to EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10) between 2025-10-06 and 2026-09-24. That rise is already in our price.

To give you planning security, we propose two complete packages, attached. The lead package covers 94800 kg per year for 24 months at a fixed price, which secures your base load. The alternative package runs for 12 months.

Which package can you sign? Is there a cheaper delivery or packaging variant we should consider?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We welcome your proposal for a 24-month contract with 30-day payment terms, and acknowledging your historical order data, we reduce our price to EUR 5.36 per unit. As we cannot maintain a fixed price over 24 months, we must introduce an AS-14404 index clause. Regarding your inquiry, our current standard delivery and packaging is already the most cost-effective method available.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Our offer stands at a price of €5.28 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.36 per unit.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Logistics: We are well loaded. Our Lieferzeit is 10 days, and with overtime we can deliver in 10 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Part:370010 - 24-month fixed-price package
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for the details on material grade and tolerance options.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

Your letter of 6 July (doc:20260706-70710-M1) states that your nickel and alloy requirement is covered at fixed prices until March 2027. A fixed price without an index clause therefore matches your own cost position. It also saves both sides the monthly surcharge administration.

The attached package covers 94800 kg per year for 24 months, with 60 days payment. Can you sign it as your primary offer? What is your earliest lead time for the first call-off?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part:370010 - 24-month fixed-price package
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. While our alloy costs are fixed until March 2027, a 24-month agreement extends significantly beyond this date, necessitating the AS-14404 index clause. In response to your inquiry, as our production is currently well loaded, our earliest lead time for the first call-off is six weeks.

We can offer a price of €5.09 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.21 per unit, under the terms of a price of €5.21 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – revised fixed-price package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for confirming the volume data.

We have moved our price a clear step towards you in the attached package. It keeps the structure of our previous proposal: 94800 kg per year, 24 months, 60 days payment, fixed price. Your alloy requirement is covered at fixed prices until March 2027 (doc:20260706-70710-M1). A fixed price therefore matches your cost position for the first months and saves both sides the monthly surcharge administration.

In April your owner offered to walk us through your calculation of hourly rates and material. We would welcome that review if it helps us close on a fixed price.

Can you sign this package as your primary offer?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – revised fixed-price package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your improved offer and are happy to arrange the meeting to review our hourly rates and material, though a fixed price over 24 months remains unfeasible. As your proposed 24-month term extends significantly beyond March 2027, we must maintain the AS-14404 index clause for the duration of the agreement. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days. Our offer stands at a price of €5.04 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.16 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
